name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions:
Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder width apart.

Take a big breath, brace your stomach, then sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.

Drive through your whole foot to stand up.
tips: Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
